name: Strings Theory
description: Explore the rich sounds of string instruments in this intimate concert at Sala 2, showcasing the versatility and beauty of the quartet format.
longDescription:
Strings Theory is a concert event dedicated to the exploration of string instruments, specifically within the quartet format. Taking place at Casa da Música, this performance focuses on the intricate interplay and diverse sonic capabilities of string ensembles. The event aims to highlight the depth and expressive range achievable through this classical chamber music configuration.

Attendees can expect an intimate musical experience in Sala 2 of Casa da Música, a venue known for its modern architecture and acoustic design. The concert will present a program designed to showcase the versatility of string instruments, offering a focused listening environment for those interested in classical and contemporary chamber music. The duration of the performance is typical for a chamber concert.

Tickets for Strings Theory are available for purchase through Casa da Música's official channels. Casa da Música is located in Boavista and is accessible via public transport, with several bus lines stopping nearby. The venue is also within walking distance from the Casa da Música metro station (lines A, B, C, E, F). Accessibility information for the venue can be found on the Casa da Música website.
